plan.colorScheme: White background, solid orange (#ff7c00) for the rotated square, black (#000000) for all axes, labels, arrows, and borders.
plan.reconstructionNotes: Ensure the x and y axes have prominent arrowheads at the positive ends. The dashed unit circle must precisely touch the 1 and -1 tick coordinates. The square is rotated by exactly 20 degrees CCW, making its bottom and top edges parallel to the tilted reference line. Use a standard LaTeX-style font for math symbols (x, y, θ).
